value.rationale: The jump from the 405 inherited complex Fermat planes to 891 Hermitian planes in characteristic two is a natural arithmetic degeneration of the projective Fano scheme. The complete monomial-group orbit partition, hexacode-vs-pairing support distinction and exact three-level intersection quotients are natural invariant data of this singularity-free but highly exceptional specialization. They detect how the 486 exceptional planes meet the inherited configuration; the line-incidence quotient has nontrivial eigenvalue 9. The exact arithmetic descent and scheme reducedness complete the classification. These are structural incidence properties beyond routine point enumeration, without claiming a new general theorem.
